id: title:eli-r-ph:publish what the deletion sweep measured

review.posthog_relevance: Changes Prometheus metric types and cleanup tracking, potentially affecting alerting and dashboard behavior.
review.reason: The chunk replaces Prometheus Counter with Gauge and removes Counter definitions, while adding tracking fields to CleanupRun. This could change how metrics accumulate and reset, potentially affecting alerting or dashboards. The added fields help track cleanup behavior, aiding debugging and alerting. No tier assignment is performed.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact on alerting and dashboards cannot be verified without checking the Prometheus configuration and dashboard dependencies. The tier assignment is based on the observed code changes, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Replaces Prometheus Counter with Gauge and removes the removed Counter definitions.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the Prometheus metric type from Counter to Gauge, which affects how the metric accumulates and resets; this could change alerting or dashboard behavior if the metric is expected to be cumulative.

observations.behavior: Removes the Counter definitions for revived persons and distinct IDs.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the Counter definitions, removing the ability to increment these counters; this could break existing dashboards or alerts that depend on these counters.

observations.behavior: Adds new fields to CleanupRun to track stranded runs, revived persons, revived distinct IDs, queued for Postgres, and mutation seconds.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds tracking for stranded runs, revived persons, revived distinct IDs, queued for Postgres, and mutation seconds; this could help with debugging and alerting.
